facts.text: I have been thinking of creating a social media content calendar to stay organized and consistent across all my platforms.
My Twitter followers have increased significantly over the past six weeks.
I currently have around 700 Twitter followers.
I want help planning my content in advance.
I want an example of a weekly content plan for Twitter based on my current follower count and engagement.
I like the idea of having a weekly theme for my Twitter content.
I am unsure if I can come up with that many different types of content.
I want to focus on one or two types of content to still see engagement.
I want to focus on educational content.
Educational content aligns with my goal of establishing myself as an expert in my industry.
I like the idea of using Twitter threads to break down complex topics into smaller chunks.
I want an example of a Twitter thread on a topic related to my industry.
I want to track the performance of my Twitter threads.
I want to know which metrics to look at to determine the success of my Twitter threads.
